newsitem.title: USA: Developers Diversified sells 1.3 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Developers Diversified sells 1.3 mln shrs.

text.p: Developers Diversified Realty Corp said Wednesday it sold 1.3 million registered common shares for net proceeds of $49.6 million.
The proceeds of the offering will be used to reduce amounts outstanding under Developers' revolving credit agreements and for general corporate purposes.
Developers said the common shares, underwritten by Lehman Brothers Inc, are included in its shelf registration which was declared effective by the Securities and Exchange Commission in June 1996.
Developers Diversifiedis a real estate investment trust which buys, leases and manages shopping center and business centers.
